name: Sika Retarder® N
summary: Sika Retarder® N is used to retard the setting time of the concrete to allow concreting under conditions of high ambient temperatures and placing of mass concrete. It is designed to be used for pumped, prestressed and structural concrete.
metaDescription: Sika Retarder® N is used to retard the setting time of the concrete to allow concreting under conditions of high ambient temperatures and placing of mass concrete. It is designed to be used for pumped, prestressed and structural concrete.
attributes: Minimises the risk of cold joints.
After the initial retardation, the rate of hardening proceeds at a rate equivalent to, or greater than, unretarded normal concrete.
Delivery of concrete can be made over long distances from the premix concrete plant.
usage: Increases the setting time of concrete
advantages: Minimises the risk of cold joints.
After the initial retardation, the rate of hardening proceeds at a rate equivalent to, or greater than, unretarded normal concrete.
Delivery of concrete can be made over long distances from the premix concrete plant.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: Sika Retarder® N meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Set-Retarding Admixture (Re)

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is at least one (1) year.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C , protected from the direct sunlight

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
Sika Retarder® N is compatible with all the types of Portland cement .
When using with other admixtures, check their compatibility first.

items.label: Concreting guidance
items.text: Concrete should be placed according to good concrete practice and proper curing procedures should take place

items.label: Specific advice
items.text: May slightly increase air content when used with water reducers.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text:
The effect of Sika Retarder® N depends on a number of factors such as cement type, ambient temperature and mix design. The optimum dosage should be determined by site or laboratory tests with the particular concrete mix design.
The rate of addition is generally in the range of: 200ml ± 100ml per 100kg of cementitious materials.
Note: For dose rates higher than 400 ml/100kg please refer to your Sika representative.
